commands.method: pip (manual install): PyTorch for NVIDIA GPU (stable)
commands.command: pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130

commands.method: pip (manual install): PyTorch for AMD GPU (ROCm 7.2, stable)
commands.command: pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/rocm7.2

commands.method: pip (manual install): PyTorch for Intel GPU (xpu)
commands.command: pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu
